text:
The dish looks like a paper plate or bowl about 15-16 cm across, filled with almonds.

The almonds seem to be heaped about one to two layers deep. Each almond weighs about 1.2 g and measures roughly 2.2 cm long. The visible area inside the dish is about 12 cm across, roughly 110 cm², and the almonds cover most of it.

For a single layer, the almonds are about 2.2 × 1.2 cm, so each occupies about 2.6 cm² and covers about 70% of the area, which gives around 30 almonds. With the heaping and a second layer, I estimate about 70 almonds. That comes to about 85 g.

Almonds have about 6 kcal per gram, so 85 g is roughly 500 kcal.
